title: Exhaustive Search Not returning results
body: ## Description Exhaustive Search is not working as expected as it used to in version 0.23 ## Steps to reproduce Notice the screenshots: Screenshot 1 Screentshot 2 ## Expected Behavior we expect to see the products seen in screenshot 1 when querying the second time in screenshot 2 ## Actual Behavior we cannot see all the products which are seen in screenshot 1 in screenshot 2 ## Metadata **Typesense Version**: 0.24

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
@reporter 

Can you please email us your cluster ID to <email-scrubbed> to help us figure out what's happening here?

comments.author: participant1
participant1
comments.body:
@reporter 

I've a fix available as a patch on 0.24 itself. Can we upgrade your cluster to this version for you to test? Do you have a staging cluster we can try first or let me know how you run Typesense locally and I can share a build (Docker or binary).

comments.body:
> Can we upgrade your cluster to this version for you to test?

yes please..

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: @reporter We've upgraded your Typesense Cloud cluster. Could you give it a shot now?

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: looks fine although im noticing the issue below now.. searching by indexed nested fields seems off.. searching the below => `shawarma spicy` we see results which is fine i guess.. now just searching `spicy` we are not seeing some of the results from above.. please note exhaustive_search argument being sent..

comments.author: participant1
reporter
comments.body: ah i see.. we are indexing the following symbols though as we noticed results where skewed with our huge dataset. im not sure now..

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: `token_separators` is still empty. With `symbols_to_index` the hyphen will be treated as a character and be indexed but it won't solve the problem of `spicy` not matching since it will still be a suffix and not infix.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: gotcha 👍 so i updated my collection as mentioned.. but still no results

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: `symbols_to_index` also contains hyphen? That takes precedence.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
i see ill need to analyze my data a bit then to see what works best..
Thanks for everything 👍

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: Fix is part of the just released `0.24.1`.
